metadata.agent_last_message:
The C++20 iCalendar tool is complete. The implementation:

**Build**: `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` produces `build/ical` (~600KB).

**Files** (12 source files, ~4400 lines total):
- `CMakeLists.txt` — Build config (only stdlib, no external deps)
- `main.cpp` — CLI entry point with `parse` and `expand` subcommands
- `json.hpp/cpp` — JSON value tree and pretty-printing serializer
- `ical.hpp` — All type declarations
- `datetime.cpp` — DATE/DATE-TIME/DURATION/UTC-OFFSET parsing & formatting
- `parser.cpp` — Line unfolding (CRLF+WSP), RFC 6868 param escapes, content lines, full component tree
- `rrule.cpp` — Full RRULE expansion (all BYxxx parts, BYSETPOS, WKST, all 7 FREQ values, dateutil-style implicit defaults)
- `timezone.cpp` — VTIMEZONE resolution with RRULE-expanded transitions, fall-back fold and spring-forward gap detection
- `expand.cpp` — Event expansion with RDATE/EXDATE, RECURRENCE-ID overrides, RANGE=THISANDFUTURE shifts, STATUS:CANCELLED, period durations
- `itip.cpp` — RFC 5546 METHOD validation across VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY
- `emit.cpp` — JSON serialization for parse and expand outputs

**Tested behaviors**: simple parsing, weekly/monthly/yearly RRULEs, BYSETPOS (last weekday of month), BYDAY ordinals (Thanksgiving, last Friday), BYWEEKNO, BYHOUR multi-time-per-day, INTERVAL, COUNT/UNTIL, EXDATE, RECURRENCE-ID single overrides, RANGE=THISANDFUTURE shifts, STATUS:CANCELLED, RDATE PERIOD with custom durations, DST transitions during recurrence, fold/gap warnings, unresolved TZID warnings, malformed input errors, line folding, text/param escapes, full ATTENDEE grammar with DELEGATED-FROM/TO, VALARM (RFC 9074), VAVAILABILITY (RFC 7953), VFREEBUSY periods, all warning kinds.

    def test_calendar_image_display_values_comma_list(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 7986 §6.1 allows the DISPLAY parameter to carry multiple values
        (comma-separated): `DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL`. The entire DISPLAY string
        should be surfaced; we accept either the raw joined string or a semantic
        split (depending on harness preference)."""
        out = run_parse(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_calprops(
                "IMAGE;VALUE=URI;DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL;FMTTYPE=image/png:"
                "https://example.com/weather-cloudy.png\n"
            ),
            tmp_path,
        )
        images = _dict_list_field(_cal(out), "images")
        assert len(images) == 1
        display = cast(str, images[0].get("display") or "")
